📖 How to use

  1. Add each person with their name and birth date.
  2. The list shows their upcoming birthday, turning age and days until.
  3. The next upcoming birthday is highlighted at the top.
  4. Everything is saved in your browser automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the countdown computed?

From today to the next occurrence of the birthday — this year's date if it is still ahead, otherwise next year's. Leap-day birthdays (Feb 29) are shown on Feb 28 in non-leap years.

Where is my list stored?

In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool — it stays on this device and browser.

Does it notify me?

No — this is a static page tool with no background notifications. Check the list weekly, or keep the tab bookmarked.
